forms.ex: Das Glas ist auf den Boden gefallen.
forms.exEn: The glass fell on the floor.

forms.clue: to stand out, to be noticed
to be cancelled; to break down
to fall over (a vase, a tree)
to swing shut by itself (a door)
to please (it pleases me: I like it)
to slip your mind; to be waived (a fee)

forms.en: arise, be incurred (costs, work); attack (an animal)
forms.clue: to arise, to be incurred (costs, work)
forms.why: an = at, onto: costs and work fall on you; a dog falls on someone.
forms.ex: Für die Reparatur fallen Kosten an.
forms.exEn: There will be costs for the repair.
forms.note: ist angefallen (costs arose); hat angefallen (a dog attacked someone).

forms.en: fall off; slope down; drop (in level)
forms.clue: to fall off (leaves); to slope down
forms.why: ab = off, down: fall off something.
forms.ex: Im Herbst fallen die Blätter ab.
forms.exEn: In autumn the leaves fall off.

forms.why: vor = forward, in front: something comes forward and happens before your eyes.
forms.ex: Was ist gestern im Büro vorgefallen?
forms.exEn: What happened in the office yesterday?

forms.en: fall down (a person, to the ground)
forms.clue: to fall down, to trip and fall (a person)
forms.why: hin = there, down to the ground.
forms.ex: Das Kind ist auf der Straße hingefallen.
forms.exEn: The child fell down in the street.

forms.en: be dropped, be cut; no longer apply
forms.clue: to be cut, to no longer apply (jobs, rules, benefits)
forms.why: weg = away: it falls away and is gone.
forms.ex: Mit dem neuen Gesetz fallen viele Regeln weg.
forms.exEn: With the new law many rules no longer apply.

forms.why: How things fall out: a case.
forms.ex: In diesem Fall rufen Sie bitte an.
forms.exEn: In that case, please call.

forms.why: des Falles: in the case that.
forms.ex: Falls du Hilfe brauchst, ruf mich an.
forms.exEn: If you need help, call me.

forms.why: un- = bad, wrong: a fall that goes wrong.
forms.ex: Sie hat einen Unfall mit dem Fahrrad gehabt.
forms.exEn: She had an accident on her bike.

forms.why: Not (need, distress) + Fall (case).
forms.ex: Im Notfall rufen Sie die 112.
forms.exEn: In an emergency, call 112.

forms.en: if need be, as a last resort
forms.clue: if need be, as a last resort
forms.why: The -s makes an adverb: in case of need.
forms.ex: Notfalls nehmen wir ein Taxi nach Hause.
forms.exEn: If need be, we'll take a taxi home.

forms.why: Rück (back) + Fall: falling back.
forms.ex: Nach drei Monaten ohne Alkohol hat er einen Rückfall gehabt.
forms.exEn: After three months without alcohol he had a relapse.

forms.why: Ton (tone) + Fall: how your voice rises and falls.
forms.ex: Mir gefällt dein Tonfall gar nicht.
forms.exEn: I don't like your tone at all.

forms.en: in any case, at any rate; anyway
forms.clue: in any case, at any rate
forms.why: jeden Falls = in every case.
forms.ex: Die Idee ist jedenfalls nicht schlecht.
forms.exEn: The idea isn't bad, at any rate.

forms.why: eben (just so) + falls: in the same case.
forms.ex: Mein Bruder wohnt ebenfalls in dieser Stadt.
forms.exEn: My brother lives in this town too.

forms.en: under no circumstances, by no means
forms.why: keines Falls = in no case.
forms.ex: Das dürfen Sie keinesfalls vergessen.
forms.exEn: You must not forget that under any circumstances.

forms.en: if necessary, if applicable (formal, written ggf.)
forms.why: gegebenen Falls = in the given case.
forms.ex: Gegebenenfalls melde ich mich noch einmal bei Ihnen.
forms.exEn: If necessary, I'll get back in touch with you.

forms.en: at most; at best, if anything
forms.why: Learn it as a word: allen Falls (in all cases) has come to mean at most.
forms.ex: Die Reparatur dauert allenfalls eine Stunde.
forms.exEn: The repair will take an hour at most.

forms.why: What falls off when you cut and prepare things.
forms.ex: Wir produzieren zu viel Abfall.
forms.exEn: We produce too much waste.

forms.clue: the failure (of a machine); a cancellation
forms.ex: Der Ausfall der Heizung ist ein großes Problem.
forms.exEn: The heating failure is a big problem.

forms.why: Food falls straight through the body.
forms.ex: Sie hat Durchfall und Fieber.
forms.exEn: She has diarrhoea and a fever.

forms.ex: Der Detektiv folgt dem Mann ganz unauffällig.
forms.exEn: The detective follows the man very discreetly.

forms.clue: the robbery, the raid (on a bank)
forms.ex: Nach dem Überfall sucht die Polizei zwei Männer.
forms.exEn: After the robbery the police are looking for two men.

forms.why: gefallen = please: a favour is something that pleases someone.
forms.note: der Gefallen (a favour) is masculine, against the das rule of a verb noun; das Gefallen means pleasure (Gefallen an etwas finden).
forms.ex: Kannst du mir einen Gefallen tun?
forms.exEn: Can you do me a favour?

forms.clue: the decay (of a building); the decline
forms.ex: Die Stadt will den Verfall der Altstadt stoppen.
forms.exEn: The town wants to stop the decay of the old town.

forms.ex: Der Zerfall des alten Reiches hat viele Jahre gedauert.
forms.exEn: The collapse of the old empire took many years.

forms.clue: the fit, the attack (of an illness)
forms.why: anfallen = attack: an illness attacks you suddenly.
forms.ex: Der Patient hat in der Nacht einen Anfall gehabt.
forms.exEn: The patient had a fit during the night.

forms.why: Schlag (blow) + Anfall (attack): a sudden attack on the brain.
forms.ex: Nach dem Schlaganfall muss er wieder sprechen lernen.
forms.exEn: After the stroke he has to learn to speak again.

forms.ex: Die Polizei untersucht den Vorfall.
forms.exEn: The police are investigating the incident.

forms.why: Learn it as a word. The old picture: you 'fall in beside' someone, i.e. take their side and approve; the applause sense came later.
forms.ex: Am Ende gab es lauten Beifall.
forms.exEn: At the end there was loud applause.

forms.en: gradient, slope; gap, disparity (between rich and poor)
forms.clue: the gradient; a gap (between rich and poor)
forms.why: ge- ... -e names the whole way something falls: a slope, a drop between two levels.
forms.note: das Gefälle: ge- ... -e collective nouns are das.
forms.ex: Das soziale Gefälle in der Stadt wird größer.
forms.exEn: The social gap in the city is growing.

forms.clue: to strike, to infest (an illness, pests)
forms.why: be- + fallen: something falls upon you or on a plant.
forms.ex: Viele Bäume sind von Schädlingen befallen.
forms.exEn: Many trees are infested with pests.

rare.why: DWDS: über jemanden herfallen = attack, pounce on
